spec.title: Alertmanager Notification Failures
spec.description: Failed Alertmanager notification requests grouped by integration and reason.

spec.expr: sum by (integration, reason) (rate(alertmanager_notifications_failed_total[$__rate_interval])) > 0 or on() vector(0)

spec.title: Alertmanager Notification Latency p99
spec.description: 99th percentile Alertmanager notification latency grouped by integration.

spec.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, integration) (rate(alertmanager_notification_latency_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) and on (integration) sum by (integration) (rate(alertmanager_notifications_total[$__rate_interval])) > 0) or on() vector(0)

spec.title: Chunk Stored Rate (compressed)
spec.description: Bytes written to storage after compression -- this, not the ingestion rate above, drives disk growth. Bursty over short intervals as chunks flush.

spec.title: Config Reload Failures
spec.description: kube-prometheus-stack config-reloader sidecars (Prometheus/Alertmanager) that failed to reload their config on the last change.

spec.title: Firing Alert Details
spec.description: Current firing alerts and their Prometheus labels.

spec.title: Firing Alerts
spec.description: Current Prometheus alerts in the firing state. Watchdog-only firing is expected and stays green.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$loki_job", route!~"ready|/grpc\\..*|/frontendv2pb\\..*|/logproto\\..*"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (route) sum by (route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$loki_job", route!~"ready|/grpc\\..*|/frontendv2pb\\..*|/logproto\\..*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

spec.title: Query Duration p99
spec.description: A slice is drawn only while queries are passing through it; a gap means no traffic in that phase, not a slow one.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, slice, cluster) (rate(prometheus_engine_query_duration_histogram_seconds_bucket{job="$prometheus_job"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (slice, cluster) sum by (slice, cluster) (rate(prometheus_engine_query_duration_histogram_seconds_count{job="$prometheus_job"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

spec.title: TSDB Size
spec.description: Bytes on disk: compacted blocks, plus the head chunks not yet compacted into them.
